notes.title: Escape First 2 is out!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35143621/761eb6e41141c7fd69753a36d46e9ef6d060fc8c.png

Hello everyone!

Escape First 2 is the second entry in the series, bringing you more rooms and more refined interactions. Gather up to six people and work together to solve puzzles and escape before time is up!

(You can play the games in either order, they are largely independent)


You can find Escape First 2 here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094060/Escape_First_2

Thank you and have a great time escaping!

notes.title: Escape First Update Patch
notes.content:
Hello Players,

We just released a new update for the game, addressing some of the issues you have brought to our attention in the last week.

Here is a brief list of some of our changes:

 Changed "Theory of Relativity" riddle and hint.
 Fixed colliders in Red Button's last room
 Improved the in-game hint for Red Button's drink riddle
 Fixed a bug with Versus mode and the "Give Hint" button.
 Fixed colliders in Lost In Time.


Thank you for playing,
    OnSkull Games

notes.title: Escape First is here!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32627052/5c11dac92ff87eaf7e60e2742b1237bcb0890502.png

Hello and welcome to Escape First!

Escape First is a multiplayer escape room adventure game that features three unique experiences to play through! Gather up to six people and work together to solve puzzles and escape before time is up!

But wait, there is more,  you can choose to play as a Team, using cooperation to win the game, or you can enable Challenge Mode hand race your friends to the exit!

Who will Escape First?

Thank you and have a great time escaping!
